generic_sampling_rules.text_identifier: Sample from the compact column's distinct values with replacement; 20% of draws are fresh near-variants (case flip, one-character edit, prefix/suffix trim) of a sampled value; never NULL for PK/NOT NULL columns.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Sample from the compact column's distinct values with replacement; 20% of draws are fresh near-variants (case flip, one-character edit) of a sampled value; NULL share per compact null_rate, but at least one NULL row per nullable column.
generic_sampling_rules.text_free: Sample from the compact column's distinct values with replacement; 15% of draws are fresh near-variants (case flip, one-character edit, truncation) of a sampled value; NULL share per compact null_rate, but at least one NULL row per nullable column.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_count: Uniform integer in [min(compact), max(compact)]; 10% of draws are one step below/above a listed boundary literal; NULL share per compact null_rate, but at least one NULL row per nullable column.
generic_sampling_rules.real_rating: Uniform real in [min(compact), max(compact)] rounded to 1 decimal; 15% of draws are one step (0.1) below/above a listed boundary literal; NULL share per compact null_rate, but at least one NULL row per nullable column.
generic_sampling_rules.real_percent: Uniform real in [0, 100] rounded to 1 decimal; NULL share per compact null_rate, but at least one NULL row per nullable column.
generic_sampling_rules.date_iso: Uniform date in [min(compact), max(compact)] formatted YYYY-MM-DD; 10% of draws are one day before/after a listed boundary literal; NULL share per compact null_rate, but at least one NULL row per nullable column.
generic_sampling_rules.boolean_text: Sample from {'true','false'} with replacement; NULL share per compact null_rate, but at least one NULL row per nullable column.
generic_sampling_rules.url: Sample from the compact column's distinct values with replacement; NULL share per compact null_rate, but at least one NULL row per nullable column.
generic_sampling_rules.long_text: Sample from the compact column's distinct values with replacement; NULL share per compact null_rate, but at least one NULL row per nullable column.
generic_sampling_rules.near_variant: For each listed equality/LIKE literal, 20% of draws are case variants (upper/lower) and one-character edits of the literal.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary: For each listed numeric literal, 15% of draws are the literal and one step on each side; for each listed date literal, one day on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.tie: For each listed ORDER column, ensure at least two rows share the tie value at the listed rank (duplicate the sampled value).
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For every nullable column, plant at least one NULL row and set the NULL share to the compact null_rate when positive, otherwise a small default share of 5-10%; NOT NULL/PK columns never get NULL. Planted NULLs are never overwritten by key dedup or FK consistency steps.
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_share: 20% of text draws are fresh values not present in the compact column.

issues.evidence: Execution feedback: n_ok=0, n_fail=20, errors={"FileNotFoundError": 20}. Every unit failed with FileNotFoundError before any instance was written (rows_added={}, n_instances=0). The failure originates in cli._one: it calls _copy_compact(a['orig'], p) where p = unit_path(...) points to <root>/<ds>/<name>/<name>.sqlite, but the parent directory <root>/<ds>/<name>/ is never created before shutil.copyfile. write_instance_sqlite does os.makedirs, but it runs only after _copy_compact, so the copy fails first.
issues.requested_revision: Create the target directory before copying, e.g. in _copy_compact call os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True) before shutil.copyfile (or call unit_path's directory creation in _one before _copy_compact). Re-run generation and confirm n_ok>0, n_fail=0, and non-empty rows_added.

issues.evidence: instance.build_random_instance applies _apply_null_rule to every nullable column including nullable FK columns, but fill_foreign_keys_consistently already fills FK columns with parent values (or None if parent empty). After _apply_null_rule, sample_fresh_primary_keys and drop_unique_duplicates may drop rows, and the self-FK fixup loop reassigns values. For a nullable FK whose parent is empty, fill_foreign_keys_consistently returns [None]*n, so the column is all NULL and the 'rows with non-NULL values' half of the NULL rule cannot hold; the code does not detect or report this. Also _apply_null_rule uses k=max(1,min(n,k)) so when n==0 no NULL is planted, and when share==0 it still forces k>=1, contradicting 'share following the compact share' for columns with zero observed NULLs (e.g. Credit.role null_rows=1 but null_in_count_column present).
issues.requested_revision: Clarify in the spec how the NULL rule interacts with empty parents and zero-share columns, and make the program honor it: for nullable FK with empty parent, either skip the column or document that all-NULL is acceptable; for zero-share columns, do not force a NULL (or state the override explicitly). Add a per-column NULL/non-NULL count to the execution summary so the rule can be verified.

issues.evidence: writer.write_instance_sqlite sets 'pragma foreign_keys = OFF' and inserts rows with executemany; on any sqlite3.Error it falls back to row-by-row and counts bad rows, but never reports which constraint failed. Combined with append=True copying the compact DB, FK integrity of appended rows is not enforced by SQLite, so unmatched_join_rows patterns (e.g. Award.episode_id child_rows_with_null_fk, Credit.episode_id) depend entirely on fill_foreign_keys_consistently. The execution feedback shows rows_skipped={} and rows_added={} only because generation failed; there is no evidence that FK consistency or PK/UNIQUE dedup actually held.
issues.requested_revision: After a successful run, add verification that appended rows satisfy FK references (or explicitly document that FK enforcement is off and rely on the sampler), and report per-table rows_ok/rows_failed from write_instance_sqlite in the CLI summary. Re-run and include the summary as evidence.

issues.evidence: The NULL rule requires that for every nullable column each instance contains generated rows with NULL and rows with non-NULL values, with a NULL share following the compact database's share. In instance.py `_apply_null_rule` skips any column whose compact NULL share is 0.0 (`if share <= 0.0 or n <= 0: continue`). The execution feedback confirms this: many nullable columns show 'generated rows: NULL 0 / n' (e.g. Award.award 0/218, Credit.role 0/1697, Episode.title 0/854, Vote.stars 0/1637, Person.name 0/943). The specification's per_column_exceptions explicitly require Award.award and Credit.role to have a NULL share of '5-30 % of generated rows', and the null_targets list includes all these columns. The program therefore does not implement the specified NULL rule for these columns.
issues.requested_revision: In `_apply_null_rule`, plant at least one NULL row for every nullable column regardless of the compact share (use the compact share when positive, otherwise a small default share such as 5-10%), so that Award.award, Credit.role, and the other nullable columns listed in null_targets receive NULLs. Ensure the planted NULLs are not overwritten by key dedup or FK consistency steps.

issues.evidence: The specification's semantic_rules_and_formulas include `Vote.percent = round(100.0 * votes / (SELECT SUM(votes) FROM Vote v2 WHERE v2.episode_id = Vote.episode_id), 1)` with supporting evidence (tt0629204: 36/203=17.7 etc.). The generation program has no code implementing this formula: values.py samples Vote.percent via `real_percent` (uniform [0,100]) and instance.py never recomputes percent from votes. The execution feedback shows Vote.percent generated rows with no NULL and no evidence of the formula being applied. This is a specified semantic rule that the program does not implement.
issues.requested_revision: Add a post-processing step in build_random_instance (or a dedicated rule pass) that, for each generated Vote row with non-NULL votes, sets percent = round(100.0 * votes / SUM(votes) over the same episode_id, 1), consistent with the specification. Handle the case where the episode total is zero (leave NULL or skip).
